Load Data and Packages
```{r}
# load packages
library(tidyverse) # data processing, plotting
library(tidyterra) # spatial data processing
library(terra) # spatial data processing
library(rnaturalearth) # spatial data processing
library(purrr) # Functional Programming
library(tidyr) # data processing
library(seacarb) # carbonate calculations
library(errors) # error propagation
library(patchwork) # plotting
library(ggplot2) # plotting
library(magrittr) # data processing
library(furrr) # parallel
library(data.table) # data processing

theme_set(theme_minimal())

base_loc <- "C:/Users/henryholm/OneDrive - Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution/Desktop/Galen_CMIP_Collab/raw_data/"

# Biome data
biomes <- terra::rast(paste0(base_loc, "Time_Varying_Biomes.nc"))
biomes <- biomes[[c("MeanBiomes")]]
crs(biomes) <- "+proj=longlat +ellips=WGS84"
biomes_vec <- as.polygons(biomes$MeanBiomes,extent = F,na.rm =F)
biomes_vec$MeanBiomes <- c(
  "No Biome",
  "NP_ICE", "NP_SPSS", "NP_STSS", "NP_STPS",
  "Pac_EQU_W", "Pac_EQU_E", "SP_STPS", "NA_ICE",
  "NA_SPSS", "NA_STSS", "NA_STPS", "Atl_EQU",
  "SA_STPS", "IND_STPS", "SO_STSS", "SO_SPSS",
  "SO_ICE"
)

# drop ice regions, land, coasts
biomes_vec <- biomes_vec[!biomes_vec$MeanBiomes %in% c("No Biome","NP_ICE","NA_ICE","SO_ICE"),]

ggplot(biomes_vec) + geom_spatvector(aes(fill = MeanBiomes)) + geom_spatvector_label(aes(label = MeanBiomes))

# area weight data
weights <- terra::rast(paste0(base_loc, "area_weights_km2.nc"))

w_df <- weights %>% as.data.frame(xy = T) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(x, y),
    values_to = "area_km2"
  ) %>% select(-name) %>% as.data.table()

# Set base directory and list NetCDF files
base_dir <- "C:/Users/henryholm/Documents/IPCC_Galen_Data/CMIP-6/decade_averages/monthly/"
all_files <- list.files(base_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "\\.nc$")
all_files <- all_files[!grepl("ensemble", all_files, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Extract metadata from filenames
file_info <- tibble::tibble(
  file = all_files,
  model = str_extract(basename(all_files), "(?<=timeseries_)[^_]+"),
  scenario = str_extract(file, "ssp[0-9]+"),
  variable = str_extract(basename(all_files), "^[^_]+")
)

# Initialize output list
cmip6 <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(file_info)) {
  cmip6[[file_info[[i, "model"]]]][[file_info[[i, "scenario"]]]][[file_info[[i, "variable"]]]] <- file_info[[i, "file"]]
}

cmip6 <- map_depth(cmip6, 3, terra::rast)

# max months for 'bloom' - get formal analysis from Anna

bloom_months <- tibble::tibble(
  biome = c(
    "NP_SPSS",
    "NP_STSS",
    "NA_SPSS",
    "NA_STSS",
    "SO_STSS",
    "SO_SPSS"
  ),
  month = list(
    c(5, 6, 7),
    c(4, 5, 6),
    c(6, 7, 8),
    c(4, 5, 6),
    c(12, 1, 2),
    c(12, 1, 2)
  )
)

# Remove uneeded temp objects
remove(i, all_files,base_dir,base_loc,file_info)

## functions 
flatten_for_plot <- function(x){
    # Flatten to a single list
    x <- list_flatten(x) %>% list_flatten()
    
    # split them
    x <- as.data.frame(data.table::rbindlist(x, idcol = "id"))
    
    matches <- str_match(x$id, "^([^_]+)_([^_]+)_(.+)$")
    x$scenario <- matches[, 2]
    x$var <- matches[, 3]
    x$biome <- matches[, 4]
    
    matches <- str_match(x$biome, "^([^_]+)_([^_]+)")
    x$loc <- matches[, 2]
    x$type <- matches[, 3]
    
    remove(matches)
    return(x)
}

```

CMIP-6 Abs and delta calculation
```{r}
# Pre-split the SpatVector by biome
biome_list <- split(biomes_vec, biomes_vec$MeanBiomes)

index_model <- names(cmip6)
index_sen   <- names(cmip6[[1]])
index_vars  <- names(cmip6[[1]][[1]])
index_zone  <- names(biome_list)

fast_spatraster_to_long_dt <- function(x) {
  dt <- as.data.table(x, xy = TRUE)
  id_vars      <- c("x", "y")
  measure_vars <- setdiff(names(dt), id_vars)
  dt <- melt(dt, id.vars = id_vars, measure.vars = measure_vars,
             variable.name = "key", value.name = "value")
  dt[, c("variable", "month") := tstrsplit(key, "_(?=[^_]+$)", perl = TRUE)]
  dt[, key := NULL]
  return(dt)
}

add_period <- function(dt) {
  dt[month %in% as.character(1:12),  period := "1850s"]
  dt[month %in% as.character(13:24), period := "2000s"]
  dt[month %in% as.character(25:36), period := "2090s"]
  dt[, month := as.character(((as.integer(month) - 1) %% 12) + 1)]
  dt
}

key_cols <- c("x", "y", "month", "model", "variable")

# Initialise output containers
cmip6_df_means <- list(
  model       = list(),
  year        = list(),
  spatial     = list(),
  total       = list(),
  total_bloom = list(),
  seasonal    = list(),
  keep_spat   = list()
)

cmip6_df_anomaly_means <- list(
  total    = list(),
  seasonal = list()
)

for (sen in index_sen) {
  for (vars in index_vars) {
    for (zone in index_zone) {

      # --- 1. Build combined data.table across models ---
      model_chunks <- vector("list", length(index_model))
      names(model_chunks) <- index_model

      for (model in index_model) {
        cat(sen, model, vars, zone, "\n")

        r  <- mask(cmip6[[model]][[sen]][[vars]], biome_list[[zone]])
        dt <- fast_spatraster_to_long_dt(r)
        rm(r); gc()

        dt <- add_period(dt)
        dt[, model := model]
        dt <- dt[w_df, on = c("x", "y"), nomatch = 0]
        dt <- dt[!is.na(variable)]

        model_chunks[[model]] <- dt
        rm(dt)
      }

      combined <- data.table::rbindlist(model_chunks, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
      rm(model_chunks); gc()

      # --- 2. Regular aggregations ---

      cmip6_df_means$model[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[, .(
        model_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        model_sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        model_min  = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        model_max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        model_se   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n          = .N 
      ), by = .(x, y, month, period)]

      cmip6_df_means$year[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[, .(
        year_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        year_sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        year_min  = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        year_max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        year_se   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n         = .N 
      ), by = .(x, y, model, period)]

      cmip6_df_means$spatial[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[, .(
        spat_mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        spat_areaW_mean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        spat_sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        spat_min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        spat_max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        spat_se         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n               = .N 
      ), by = .(model, month, period)]

      cmip6_df_means$total[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[, .(
        mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        areaW_mean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        se         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n          = .N 
      ), by = .(period)]

      if (zone %in% bloom_months$biome) {
        bloom <- unlist(bloom_months[bloom_months$biome == zone, "month"][[1]])
        cmip6_df_means$total_bloom[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[month %in% bloom, .(
          mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          areaW_mean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
          se         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
          n          = .N
        ), by = .(period)]
      }

      cmip6_df_means$seasonal[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[, .(
        seas_mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_areaW_mean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_se         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n               = .N
      ), by = .(month, period)]

      cmip6_df_means$keep_spat[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- combined[, .(
        keep_spat_mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        keep_spat_sd   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        keep_spat_min  = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        keep_spat_max  = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        keep_spat_se   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n              = .N
      ), by = .(x, y, period, area_km2)]

      # --- 3. Anomalies ---
      # Extract 2000s baseline once and reuse for both anomaly comparisons
      dt_2000s <- combined[period == "2000s", .SD, .SDcols = c(key_cols, "value")]
      setnames(dt_2000s, "value", "value_2000s")

      # Merge baseline into 1850s and 2090s, compute anomalies, bind
      a_1850 <- merge(combined[period == "1850s"], dt_2000s, by = key_cols)
      a_1850[, `:=`(value = value - value_2000s, period = "1850s-2000s")][, value_2000s := NULL]

      a_2090 <- merge(combined[period == "2090s"], dt_2000s, by = key_cols)
      a_2090[, `:=`(value = value - value_2000s, period = "2090s-2000s")][, value_2000s := NULL]

      rm(dt_2000s)

      anomaly <- rbind(a_1850, a_2090)
      rm(a_1850, a_2090)

      # Anomaly aggregations
      cmip6_df_anomaly_means$total[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- anomaly[, .(
        mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        areaW_mean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        se         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n          = .N
      ), by = .(period)]

      cmip6_df_anomaly_means$seasonal[[sen]][[vars]][[zone]] <- anomaly[, .(
        seas_mean       = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_areaW_mean = weighted.mean(value, area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_sd         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_min        = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_max        = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        seas_se         = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N),
        n               = .N
      ), by = .(month, period)]

      rm(anomaly, combined); gc()
    }
  }
}

# Clean up source data
rm(cmip6, w_df, weights); gc()

# Drop NULL entries from total_bloom
cmip6_df_means$total_bloom <- cmip6_df_means$total_bloom |>
  modify_depth(3, ~ if (is.atomic(.x) && length(.x) == 1 && is.na(.x)) NULL else .x) |>
  modify_depth(2, discard, is.null) |>
  modify_depth(1, discard, is.null)
```

```{r}

delta <- flatten_for_plot(cmip6_df_anomaly_means$total)

                   )

delta <- delta %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(scenario, biome, loc, type, period),
    names_from = var, values_from = c(areaW_mean_delta, sd_delta,areaW_mean_abs,sd_abs,min_delta,max_delta)
  )

delta$type <- factor(delta$type,levels = c("EQU","STPS","STSS","SPSS","ICE"))

delta$p_s <-  paste(delta$scenario, delta$period,  sep = " - ")

delta[which(delta$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 1850s","ssp585 - 1850s")),"p_s"] <- "Historical , 1850s"
delta[which(delta$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 1850s","ssp585 - 1850s")),"p_s"] <- "Historical , 1850s"
delta[which(delta$p_s %in% c("ssp585 - 2090s")),"p_s"] <- "SSP5-8.5 , 2090s"
delta[which(delta$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 2090s")),"p_s"] <- "SSP2-4.5 , 2090s"

plot_delta <- function(data, var_x_suffix, var_y_suffix, y_lab = NA, x_lab = NA) {
  
  # Check for missing or NA character labels
  if (missing(y_lab) || (is.character(y_lab) && length(y_lab) == 1 && is.na(y_lab))) {
    y_lab <- var_y_suffix
  }
  if (missing(x_lab) || (is.character(x_lab) && length(x_lab) == 1 && is.na(x_lab))) {
    x_lab <- var_x_suffix
  }
  
  x_col <- paste0("areaW_mean_delta_", var_x_suffix)
  y_col <- paste0("areaW_mean_delta_", var_y_suffix)
  sd_x_col <- paste0("sd_delta_", var_x_suffix)
  sd_y_col <- paste0("sd_delta_", var_y_suffix)
  
  x_sym <- rlang::sym(x_col)
  y_sym <- rlang::sym(y_col)
  sd_x_sym <- rlang::sym(sd_x_col)
  sd_y_sym <- rlang::sym(sd_y_col)
  
  ggplot(
    data %>% subset(type != "ICE" & period != "2000s"),
    aes(x = !!x_sym, y = !!y_sym, color = p_s,shape = type)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(
      ymin = !!y_sym - !!sd_y_sym,
      ymax = !!y_sym + !!sd_y_sym
    ),linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(
      xmin = !!x_sym - !!sd_x_sym,
      xmax = !!x_sym + !!sd_x_sym
    ),linewidth = 0.1) +
    labs(
      y = if (is.expression(y_lab)) y_lab else paste0(y_lab),
      x = if (is.expression(x_lab)) x_lab else paste0(x_lab),
      color = "Period and Scenario", shape = "Biome Type"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey50", "orange", "maroon")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(15:17,4))
}

# set axis labels 
dhco3 <- expression(paste("Δ [HCO"[3]^"-","]", " (", "umol ", kg^{-1}, ")"))
dco2 <- expression("Δ [CO"[2]*"] (umol kg"^{-1}*")")
dco3 <- expression(paste("Δ [CO"[3]^"-2","]", " (", "umol ", kg^{-1}, ")"))
dtemp <- "Δ Temperature (°C)"
dpco2 <- expression("Δ pCO"[2]*"")

# get legend
legend <- ggpubr::get_legend(plot_delta(delta,"tos","pCO2",x_lab = dtemp,y_lab = dpco2) + theme(legend.position = "top"))

fig1_bottom <- (
  plot_delta(delta,"tos","pCO2", x_lab = dtemp, y_lab = dpco2) +
    plot_delta(delta,"aqueous","pCO2", x_lab = dco2, y_lab = dpco2) + 
    plot_delta(delta,"bicarbonate","pCO2", x_lab = dhco3, y_lab = dpco2) + 
    plot_delta(delta,"carbonate","pCO2", x_lab = dco3, y_lab = dpco2) +
    plot_delta(delta,"pH","pCO2", x_lab = "Δ pH (Total Scale)", y_lab = dpco2) +
    plot_delta(delta,"dic","pCO2", x_lab = expression("Δ DIC (umol kg"^{-1}*")"), y_lab = dpco2) 
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", nrow = 1, axes = "collect") &
  #plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("G", "H", "I","J", "K", "L"))) 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      #family = "Arial",
      size  = 12,
      hjust = -0.1,
      vjust = 1.1
    )
  )
```

Figure 1 - Absolute Conditions
```{r}
# extract data
abs <- flatten_for_plot(cmip6_df_means$total)

# some refactoring
abs <- abs %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(scenario, biome, loc, type, period),
    names_from = var, values_from = c(areaW_mean, sd, min, max)
  )

abs$type <- factor(abs$type,levels = c("EQU","STPS","STSS","SPSS","ICE"))

abs$p_s <-  paste(abs$scenario, abs$period,  sep = " - ")

abs[which(abs$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 1850s","ssp585 - 1850s")),"p_s"] <- "Historical , 1850s"
abs[which(abs$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 1850s","ssp585 - 1850s")),"p_s"] <- "Historical , 1850s"
abs[which(abs$p_s %in% c("ssp585 - 2090s")),"p_s"] <- "SSP5-8.5 , 2090s"
abs[which(abs$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 2090s")),"p_s"] <- "SSP2-4.5 , 2090s"
abs[which(abs$p_s %in% c("ssp585 - 2000s")),"p_s"] <- "Modern , 2000s"
abs[which(abs$p_s %in% c("ssp245 - 2000s")),"p_s"] <- "Modern , 2000s"

abs$p_s <- factor(abs$p_s,levels = c("Historical , 1850s",
                                     "Modern , 2000s",
                                     "SSP2-4.5 , 2090s",
                                     "SSP5-8.5 , 2090s"))

# helper function
plot_abs_data <- function(data, 
                          xvar, yvar,
                          xlab = NULL, ylab = NULL,sdevs = 1) {
  
  # Capture variable names
  x_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(xvar))
  y_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::enquo(yvar))
  
  # find sd columns
  sd_x_name <- paste0("sd_", sub("^areaW_mean_", "", x_name))
  sd_y_name <- paste0("sd_", sub("^areaW_mean_", "", y_name))
  
  # Check if they exist, else set NULL
  sd_x <- if (sd_x_name %in% names(data)) rlang::sym(sd_x_name) else NULL
  sd_y <- if (sd_y_name %in% names(data)) rlang::sym(sd_y_name) else NULL
  
  ggplot_data <- data %>%
    subset(type != "ICE") %>%
    group_by(scenario, biome, loc, type, period) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  p <- ggplot(ggplot_data, aes(x = {{ xvar }}, y = {{ yvar }},
                               color = p_s, shape = type)) +
    geom_point()
  
  # Add error bars if found
  if (!is.null(sd_y)) {
    p <- p + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = {{ yvar }} - !!sd_y*sdevs,
                               ymax = {{ yvar }} + !!sd_y*sdevs),
                           linewidth = 0.1)
  }
  if (!is.null(sd_x)) {
    p <- p + geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = {{ xvar }} - !!sd_x*sdevs,
                               xmax = {{ xvar }} + !!sd_x*sdevs),
                           linewidth = 0.1)
  }
  
  p +
    labs(
      x = ifelse(is.null(xlab), x_name, xlab),
      y = ifelse(is.null(ylab), y_name, ylab),
      color = "Period and Scenario", 
      shape = "Biome Type"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("grey50","#3295a8","orange","maroon")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(15:17,4))
}

hco3 <- expression(paste("[HCO"[3]^"-","]", " (", "umol ", kg^{-1}, ")"))
co2 <- expression("[CO"[2]*"] (umol kg"^{-1}*")")
co3 <- expression(paste("[CO"[3]^"-2","]", " (", "umol ", kg^{-1}, ")"))
temp <- "Temperature (°C)"
pco2 <- expression("pCO"[2]*"")

  plot_abs_data(abs,
    xvar = areaW_mean_abs_tos, yvar = areaW_mean_abs_pCO2,

  ) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  plot_abs_data(abs,
    xvar = areaW_mean_abs_aqueous, yvar = areaW_mean_abs_pCO2,

  plot_abs_data(abs,
    xvar = areaW_mean_abs_bicarbonate, yvar = areaW_mean_abs_pCO2,
    xlab = hco3, ylab = pco2
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  plot_abs_data(abs,
    xvar = areaW_mean_abs_carbonate, yvar = areaW_mean_abs_pCO2,
    xlab = co3, ylab = pco2
  ) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  plot_abs_data(abs,
    xvar = areaW_mean_abs_pH, yvar = areaW_mean_abs_pCO2,

  ) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  plot_abs_data(abs,
    xvar = areaW_mean_abs_dic, yvar = areaW_mean_abs_pCO2,

  ) + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) 
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", nrow = 1, axes = "collect") &

  theme(

     # family = "Arial",

    )
  )

fig1_ab_supp <- (
```
